question: How is the state devoid of māyā described in traditional teaching?
premises: A state separated from māyā is described
Night-time serves as an image of obscurity
inference: The condition without māyā is traditionally depicted as a dark or unmanifest state.
uncertainties: The subject described as māyā-virahitaḥ is implicit
niśākāle may be literal or metaphorical
plain_english: As long as one is devoid of māyā, it is sung of as being in the time of night.
